title: Tip of the Week: Hundreds of Compliance Forms and Support Documents at your Fingertips
titleTag: Tip of the Week: Hundreds of Compliance Forms and Support Documents at your Fingertips
description: If you are searching for any forms or documents to help manage your office or support your compliance program, look no further than our website.
body:
If you are searching for any forms or documents to help manage your office or support your compliance program, look no further than our website.

Our "Forms Section" contains hundreds of compliance and support documents right at your fingertips. Once you login and open one of your offices under "My Offices" you arrive at your dashboard. Along the left hand side of the page you will see several gray tabs. Now click on the "Forms" tab and type a relevant key word into the search bar. Or use the category search bar to search within our Compliance Categories.

You can use these steps to access numerous forms. (See our Bloodborne Pathogen or Certified Medical Assistant recertification information or our recently updated eyewash station and fire extinguisher documents for example).

These documents and forms support your compliance program and office management in the following categories:

Business Associates

H/R

HIPAA Privacy

HIPAA Security

OIG/CMS

OSHA

My Forms (We allow you to upload your own private documents into your very own Forms Category. Information on uploading your own forms is included in next week's tip).

As always, if you have any questions about this tip or any other compliance or website question; please call or email and one of our support personnel will be happy to assist you.
